summary: Iteration 2 backend verification: 33/33 pytest tests pass (17 new + 16 regression). Bug fix VERIFIED: POST /api/clubs still returns approved=false, but GET /api/clubs now correctly returns the author's own pending club (via $or approved:true OR suggested_by:me), while other users do NOT see it. Also confirmed pending region does not leak in GET /api/clubs/regions. Seed data VERIFIED: all 6 demo users login (marc/julie/thomas/sophie/kevin/lea @padel.fr / password123), each has non-null avatar_url, level ∈ LEVELS, reliability_avg > 0 and reliability_count > 0. Clubs list: 12 clubs; >=3 clubs carry announcements_count>0; total announcements across clubs is 12 (≈10 seeded + 2 accumulated TEST ones). Announcements are correctly enriched with author (pseudo/level/reliability_avg > 0 for demo users). Filters: ?region=Occitanie returns Padel Toulouse Sud + Montpellier Padel Sud; ?search=Paris matches Padel Horizon Paris; combined region+search works. Regression: login marc, GET /api/auth/me, POST /api/messages private DM, POST /api/users/{id}/rate all pass.
action_items: No backend action items — bug fix and new seed data are working as specified. Frontend testing was NOT requested this iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: list_clubs query composition is correct: base {$or: [approved, suggested_by:me]} then wrapped with $and when region and/or search filters are added (verified via test_region_and_search_combined + test_pending_club_hidden_from_regions_list).
Seed is idempotent-per-collection but not idempotent per user set: adding a 7th demo user later would require a wipe (current DB was wiped this iteration as noted).
Announcement seed picks random author across all users incl. TEST_ users if present; because seed only runs when announcements collection is empty, this is fine after a fresh wipe.
GET /api/clubs/regions correctly filters approved:True — verified pending region 'TestRegionXYZ' does NOT leak.
